--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.SmoothNumbers
@[simp]
lemma primesBelow_zero : primesBelow 0 = ∅ := by
  rw [primesBelow, Finset.range_zero, Finset.filter_empty]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
@[simp]
theorem one_lt_mersenne {p : ℕ} : 1 < mersenne p ↔ 1 < p :=
  mersenne_lt_mersenne (p := 1)

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Factorization.Basic
theorem setOf_pow_dvd_eq_Icc_factorization {n p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    { i : ℕ | i ≠ 0 ∧ p ^ i ∣ n } = Set.Icc 1 (n.factorization p) := by
  ext
  simp [Nat.lt_succ_iff, one_le_iff_ne_zero, pp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Defs
@[csimp] theorem decidablePrime_csimp :
    @decidablePrime = @decidablePrime' := by
  funext; apply Subsingleton.elim

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.FactorisationProperties
theorem Prime.not_perfect (h : Prime p) : ¬ Perfect p := by
  have h1 := Prime.not_pseudoperfect h
  revert h1
  exact not_imp_not.mpr (Perfect.pseudoperfect)

--src: Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.PiNat
/-- `cylinder x n` is equal to the set of sequences `y` with the same restriction to `n` as `x`. -/
theorem cylinder_eq_res (x : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ) :
    cylinder x n = { y | res y n = res x n } := by
  ext y
  dsimp [cylinder]
  rw [res_eq_res]

--src: Mathlib.Combinatorics.Schnirelmann
lemma schnirelmannDensity_setOf_modeq_one {m : ℕ} :
    schnirelmannDensity {n | n ≡ 1 [MOD m]} = (m⁻¹ : ℝ) := by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 1 with rfl | hm
  · simp [Nat.modEq_one]
  rw [← schnirelmannDensity_setOf_mod_eq_one hm]
  apply schnirelmannDensity_congr
  ext n
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Nat.ModEq, Nat.one_mod_eq_one.mpr hm]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.SmoothNumbers
/-- The non-zero non-`N`-smooth numbers are `≥ N`. -/
lemma smoothNumbers_compl (N : ℕ) : (N.smoothNumbers)ᶜ \ {0} ⊆ {n | N ≤ n} := by
  simpa only [smoothNumbers_eq_factoredNumbers]
    using factoredNumbers_compl <| Finset.filter_subset _ (Finset.range N)

--src: Mathlib.Data.PNat.Prime
theorem coe_pnat_injective : Function.Injective ((↑) : Nat.Primes → ℕ+) := fun p q h =>
  Subtype.ext (by injection h)

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Basic
theorem nmem_setOf_iff {a : α} {p : α → Prop} : a ∉ { x | p x } ↔ ¬p a :=
  Iff.rfl
